description: Sealambda dependency update policy. A repository extends it with github>sealambda/.github and adds its own managers, constraints and package rules.
It builds on config:best-practices, which pins GitHub Actions and Docker images by digest, and sets the commit type to build and the label to dependencies.

A release waits 7 days before Renovate proposes it, so a withdrawn or compromised release is less likely to reach a repository. A security fix, a lock file maintenance and a Nix flake input that follows a Git ref have no wait. The Renovate schedule and the lock file maintenance run on Monday mornings and on the first day of the month, in UTC.
The preset turns the Nix manager on, which Renovate leaves off by default. The manager keeps the flake.lock files up to date.

packageRules.description: A package from the npm registry, which pnpm installs from, waits 7 days like every other release. config:best-practices shortens the wait for that registry to 3 days.
Renovate cannot check the age of these update types, because they have no release date. Without this rule the age check stays pending and Renovate never creates the branch.
A flake input that follows a Git ref has no release date, so its age cannot be checked.
A development dependency keeps the range that its manifest declares. config:best-practices pins it to one version, and the lock file already fixes the resolved version.
Mix: one pull request for the minor and patch versions.
pnpm: one pull request for the minor and patch versions. Renovate names its manager for package.json files npm, and it reads pnpm-lock.yaml through that manager.
The Elixir quality tools update in one pull request for the minor and patch versions.
The actions that the workflows pin by commit SHA, with the version in a comment: one pull request for the minor and patch versions of all of them.
OpenTofu providers come from the OpenTofu registry, the one that tofu init uses.
required_version names OpenTofu, which Renovate would look up as Terraform; the development shell decides the OpenTofu version.

A security fix inside the declared range changes only the lock file. It skips the 7 days of waiting, and Renovate merges it after the checks pass. This rule and the next apply to the updates that Renovate finds by its normal lookup. A fix for a transitive dependency is a remediation, and Renovate builds it from vulnerabilityAlerts without package rules. It opens without the label security and without automerge, and a person merges it.
Any other security fix changes a declared range or a major version. It opens as a draft pull request. A person reviews it, and Renovate never merges it.

A reusable workflow of this hub is pinned by commit SHA with the branch name in a comment. A digest update of that pin has no release date, so its age cannot be checked. It opens its own pull request, because it changes the checks of the repository, and Renovate never merges it. This rule comes last, so that no other rule can turn the merge on or change the group.
